The water seems to materialize in mid-air or blend seamlessly from the hull without a mechanical source, violating physical causality.

The water spray has a smoky, gaseous quality rather than a liquid droplet appearance. The texture lacks the sharpness and refraction expected of high-pressure water, resembling generated noise or smoke.
The geometry of the cruise ship's stern appears slightly warped and inconsistent with standard naval architecture, though less severe than the foreground artifacts.
